idea: Infrastructure project financial modelling for funds
pain: Project models are built badly and nobody checks the construction assumptions
v1: One project model or model review
verdict: Strong fees and a real tailwind, but infra modelling is a specialist craft with established providers.

why.distribution: Infra funds are adjacent to her direct network.
why.demand: Model audit and build is a real paid category in project finance.
why.fmf: Modelling and construction literacy transfer; project finance modelling conventions are their own discipline.
why.defensibility: Specialist model audit firms hold this market with named credentials.
why.time_to_revenue: 3-6 months to build credibility in a new convention.
why.tailwind: Infrastructure and energy capex is booming.
why.ceiling: £15k x 14 projects = £210k, requiring a deal flow she does not have.

ceiling_arithmetic: £15k x 14 projects = £210k. Reaching fourteen infrastructure projects a year requires established fund relationships. Realistic: 3-5 = £45-75k.
carries: Genuine capex tailwind and high fees.
kills: Project finance modelling is a credentialled specialism where incumbents have decades of precedent.
test: Ask two infra funds who audits their project models.
test_pass: They describe dissatisfaction or capacity constraints.
test_fail: They name a specialist firm on retainer.
